summary: Write 'hostname' as one word, and write ID in all caps for identification or identifier, never Id or id.
questions: Should I write 'User Id' or 'User ID'?

answer_card.title: Hostname and ID
answer_card.answer_md:
- **hostname**: one word, not "host name".
- **ID**: all uppercase for identification/identifier ("User ID", "Resource ID"), never "Id" or "id".
